answer: In an agent economy sybil resistance requires each identity to keep a live beacon of unique useful computation inside a shared orchard of collective problems, validity resting on a trellis of cross-attestations from unrelated peers. Spinning N fakes forces the attacker to fund N independent non-amortizable compute streams; the orchard assigns distinct subproblems and the trellis flags correlated proofs, so cost scales linearly with N while detection probability rises with trellis density.
